&6Orange&r (2) -> This is a setup from &bAE2 guides&r, to make fluix and sky steel, if you don't want to use reaction chambers.

quest.7656D71CE6F49D32.quest_desc: We are using &dsubnets&r to get this trick going.
Place an &astorage bus&r somewhere in your &dnetwork&r that has 1 &achannel&r.
Then, place an &binterface&r on the other side of the &astorage bus&r, like if it was a chest.
Now, you can use that &dsubnetwork&r to store more &eitems&r or &9fluids&r or whatever!
This is because an &binterface&r exposes all the &cstorages&r of a &dnetwork&r to a &astorage bus&r, acting like a chest to the storage bus.
Also, you can filter the &astorage bus&r to only send 1 specific thing
